card.name: Words right before "medical" in advice
card.fires_on: The word just before "medical" in warnings, such as "immediate" or "prompt" after "seek", or "to" in "hypersensitivity to medical adhesives".

modes.label: Urgency before medical care
modes.description: An urgency word such as immediate or prompt that comes right before "medical care", "medical help" or "medical attention".

card.writes: It suppresses the word "medical" in several languages, so the next word is less likely to be "medical".
